products.title: The Reading Society — Owl Annotation Pouch
products.description:
A little home for the things between the pages. Keep pens, annotation tabs, bookmarks and small reading tools together in this cream cotton canvas zipper pouch. Sold empty; stationery and other accessories are not included.

The front pairs The Reading Society typography with Great Cinereous Owl (1837), engraved by Robert Havell after John James Audubon. The historical museum reproduction is shown in full, including its paper tone and age marks. Public-domain artwork from the National Gallery of Art, Washington, Gift of Mrs. Walter B. James. Layout by The Books Wanderer.

100% cotton canvas, approximately 8.3 × 7.8 inches (21.1 × 19.8 cm), with cream zipper and an attached carrying strap. One-sided print; the reverse is plain. This is an accessory pouch, not a padded book sleeve, and it is not sized for an A5 notebook. Printed wording is in English.

Printed to order in the United States by District Photo through Printify, using an imported blank. US delivery only. Standard US shipping is included; estimated delivery 5–10 days.

products.title: Letters from the Library — Lake Suwa Cards & Envelopes (10)
products.description:
A small landscape. A few handwritten lines. Send a thank-you, a book recommendation or a note to someone you miss with this set of ten matching correspondence cards and ten envelopes. All ten cards carry the same Lake Suwa design; this is not a mixed-artwork set.

The front reproduces Lake Suwa in Shinano Province (ca. 1830–32), by Katsushika Hokusai, from Thirty-six Views of Mount Fuji. The complete composition is framed on the card. Public-domain artwork from The Metropolitan Museum of Art, Henry L. Phillips Collection; Open Access / CC0. Layout by The Books Wanderer.

Flat, horizontal cards measuring approximately 4.9 × 3.5 inches (12.4 × 8.9 cm), on uncoated white paper. Printed on both sides: an illustrated front and a lightly ruled reverse with the English words “A note from my corner of the world” and “Dear”, plus the artwork credit. These cards do not fold. Envelopes are included; postage stamps are not.

Printed to order in the United States by Taylor through Printify. US delivery only. Standard US shipping is included; estimated delivery 5–10 days.
